title: Prepaid Dental HMO Plans Evidence of Coverage — Schedule of Crowns, Dentures, Implants and Cosmetic Services
content:
**Schedule C to the Evidence of Coverage, Prepaid Dental HMO Plans.** This schedule sets the member's copay for porcelain-fused-to-base-metal crowns, the additional amount for noble or high-noble metal, complete dentures and endosteal implants, and records whether implants and cosmetic services are covered under each Cascade DentalCare DHMO plan.

### C.1 Terms of the schedule

(a) *Crown copay*: USD per porcelain-fused-to-base-metal crown.
(b) *Noble metal upcharge*: USD additional per crown or pontic using noble or high-noble metal.
(c) *Complete denture copay*: USD per complete upper or lower denture.
(d) *Implants covered*: true means endosteal implants are covered at the implant copay.
(e) *Implant copay*: USD per implant body when implants are covered; 0.00 when not covered.
(f) *Cosmetic services covered*: false means cosmetic services (whitening, veneers) are not covered.

### C.2 Amounts

| Plan | Crown, porcelain fused to base metal | Noble metal upcharge, per crown or pontic | Complete denture, upper or lower | Implants covered | Implant copay, per implant body | Cosmetic services covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 | 525.00 | 125.00 | 595.00 | No | 0.00 | No |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 315 | 475.00 | 125.00 | 540.00 | No | 0.00 | No |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 415 | 425.00 | 100.00 | 490.00 | No | 0.00 | No |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 515 | 375.00 | 100.00 | 440.00 | No | 0.00 | No |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 | 325.00 | 75.00 | 390.00 | Yes | 1550.00 | No |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 | 275.00 | 75.00 | 340.00 | Yes | 1350.00 | No |

### C.3 Notes

1. Implants are covered only under the Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 (implant copay 1550.00 per implant body) and the Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 (1350.00 per implant body). Under the DHMO 215, 315, 415 and 515 implants are not covered and the implant copay is shown as 0.00; the 0.00 is the schedule's mark of non-coverage, not a free implant.
2. Cosmetic services such as whitening and veneers are not covered under any plan in this schedule.
3. The noble metal upcharge is an amount *added* for each crown or pontic made with noble or high-noble metal.

### C.4 Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical member on the Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 receives one crown made with high-noble metal. The member's amount for that crown is the crown copay of 325.00 plus the noble metal upcharge of 75.00, a total of 400.00. The same crown in porcelain fused to base metal carries the crown copay of 325.00 alone.
